src/sim/rehearsal.ts briefs (:457 'Usual spend', :533 'real limits', :563 questionForOwner, and the round-1 situation that narrates the board and the sponsored post to everyone). The AI-played run shows three artefacts of the brief. (1) 6 of 6 noticed the board on day 1, against 2 of 6 in the rule-based demo. (2) Every round 1-2 thought (11 of 11) weighs €9.90 against the persona's own usual spend, and 7 quote the exact figure ('meinen 10,80 €', 'meine 7,20 €'). People do not talk like that. (3) 23 of 23 reactions carry a question, although the field is optional. Fix: give each persona their own exposure line, built from their channels and routine ('Sie kommen montags nicht durch diese Straße; Instagram sehen Sie nur, wenn…'). Give the usual spend as a feeling ('etwas mehr, als Sie mittags sonst zahlen') and say 'do not quote your own budget figure'. Write 'most rounds you would not ask anything'. Criterion: briefs; an imagined person who reacts as a person would. Check: after a replay, R1 noticing is clearly below 6/6, at most half the thoughts cite a euro figure, and the median is at most 2 questions per persona over 4 rounds.

src/sim/rehearsal.ts summarize → questionsFor (:1747) and checksFor (:1777) do not distil a model-played run. /r#demo-ai shows 'In ihren Worten: 4 Zitate, 23 Fragen an Sie' with near-duplicates. 7 of the 23 questions ask for a smaller or cheaper version without the sandwich (Paweł and Greta in every round). 5 ask whether the deal stays, and 4 ask for a child's portion. The checklist quotes only Noor's and Chiara's round-1 questions and misses the run's clearest signal: 2 of 6 found €9.90 too much for the bundle. Fix: group questions by topic (price or portion, permanence, children or allergens, speed or take-away) and keep one per person per topic. Let checksFor name the biggest group with a count, e.g. '2 von 6 ausgedachten Gästen fragten nach Suppe und Getränk unter 8 €: Fragen Sie echte Gäste danach'. Criterion: honest summary; sharper questions for real customers. Check: the AI demo shows at most 8 grouped questions, and the checklist names the price/portion group with its count.

The price template. (a) Persona cards contradict themselves in 92 of 300 price runs: a night-shift job ('fährt nachts Taxi und frühstückt hier mittags', 'Krankenpfleger in der Nachtschicht … auf dem Heimweg') is paired with a morning routine ('fast jeden Morgen … oft als erster Gast', 'every morning on the way to work'). The shipped /r#demo-price has one: Hoa, 71. Tag each job with its time of day and draw only routines that fit. (b) 'new (you have hardly or never been inside)' customers talk as if they knew the old price. In /r#demo-price, Felix says '20 Cent mehr', says publicly 'Etwas teurer als früher', and answers the interview with 'Ich komme weiter zu meinen üblichen Zeiten'. Over 240 price runs: 124 reactions and 93 interview answers ('30 cents more for the same flat white', 'I still buy here, same as before'). Give new customers lines about the price itself ('4,10 € ist normal hier'), and skip the 'kept' and 'less' interview facts for them (demo.ts factsFor). Criterion: personas and continuity. Check: a sim test over 300 price seeds with no night/morning pairs and no old-price words from new customers.
